description: Begin uploading a new video from the user's computer. Files cannot be sent through this connection: the tool returns an upload_url the user opens in their browser (signed in to Vidreno) to pick the file; the upload goes straight to Vidreno's storage with the metadata given here pre-filled. Afterwards call get_upload_status with the upload_id to get the finished video and its embed code. Links are single-use and expire after about an hour. This is also the right tool when the user attached the video in the chat unless this AI app can supply a temporary https download URL for the attachment (ChatGPT can; use upload_video_from_chat there).

description.description: Description to give the video once uploaded.

title.description: Title to give the video once uploaded.
